data.one_liner: Type-safe DateTime and Duration calculations, powered by extensions.
data.what_it_does: Provides convenient Dart extensions for DateTime and Duration objects. Allows writing expressive time-based calculations like `10.minutes` or `5.minutes.fromNow` and adds helpers for comparison, ranges, and `copyWith`.
use_when: You want readable and expressive time and duration math in your Dart or Flutter project.
You frequently need to add or subtract time using intuitive syntax.
avoid_when: You require robust, localized date formatting and parsing (use intl instead).
strengths: Extremely clean and readable syntax inspired by Swift and Kotlin.
Zero boilerplate with no code generation required.
weaknesses: Relies on global extensions which might pollute auto-complete if not desired.
data.setup_notes: Simply add to pubspec.yaml and import 'package:time/time.dart'.
data.minimal_example:
final Duration tenMinutes = 10.minutes;
final DateTime tenMinutesFromNow = 10.minutes.fromNow;
